brief: Indian shares are surging, with the Sensex up over 1,700 points and Nifty above 25,800 as IT stocks gain about 2%. Falling oil prices and a strong GIFT Nifty signal are helping, though Asian markets slid on an AI selloff and US tariff worries.
themes: Oil prices fall on supply glut
Asian AI selloff and tariff worries
